contents_index.label_categories: [] — triples-only by decision DP-B11; the slot channel is unused for this domain.
contents_index.merge_prohibited_type_pairs: The full cross-type set — all 10 unordered pairs among the 5 entity types (schema_front MP-1 expressed as pairs: never merge across types; same-type merges remain legal). Binds WRITE ER in both channels.
contents_index.metadata_declarations: Per-run parameter declarations mirrored in the payload (triple_threshold, review_band, er_threshold, er_cross_doc_min_p_same, embed_model, chunking, batch_cost_cap_usd, provider_sort). Declarations, not live values — BatchConfig governs the run (docs/PACK_DESIGN.md §3).
contents_index.pair_judge: pair_enumeration on, pair_window sentence, roster_pass on; pair judge variant J3 (pair_judge_context=abstract x pair_judge_instruction=evidence) selected by the factorial fitting (conformance CR-2).
contents_index.schema_front: Closed entity inventory (6 types: GeneOrGeneProduct, DiseaseOrPhenotypicFeature, ChemicalEntity, SequenceVariant, CellLine [entities]; OrganismTaxon [qualifier, never an entity]) with definitions + boundary examples, closed relation inventory (8 types: Association, Positive_Correlation, Negative_Correlation, Bind, Cotreatment, Comparison, Conversion, Drug_Interaction) with endpoint signatures + extraction intents, merge prohibitions MP-1/MP-2. Rendered into proposer guidance by the profile channel (derive_guidance).

convention_notes.note: Treatment language in the pair sentence patterns with gold Negative_Correlation (35.6% of the R9 NegCorr->Assoc failure sentences; 29.8% of Train gold NegCorr sentences vs an 11.1% explicit-negation-cue rate). Aggregate anatomy only (the round-9 design record, §2); never written into guidance — the one attempt to carry boundary content into instructions (candidate T1) measured negative (conformance CR-3).

Membership / receptor language patterns with gold Bind (13 of 14 R9 Bind->Assoc failures; Train gold Bind carries it in 54.1% of sentences vs 24.6% explicit binding stems). The payload's Bind definition invites stated physical binding only — the mismatch is recorded, not silently repaired (the round-9 design record, §2).

Cue presence never determines gold type on this corpus: 40.2% of Train gold Association sentences carry another type's cue. Any future convention content is therefore a prior, not a rule, and must be priced by the conformance spec (docs/PACK_DESIGN.md §2) before adoption.

payload.note: The loader file (profile/setup_config.json, beside this manifest) is byte-identical to this pinned file (asserted by the pack test and by the pack freeze). The pack binds the payload by pin; it never forks its content. Pack 0.2.0 (2026-10-19): the payload gained one declared key, pair_judge_generic_relation, carrying the generic-member name the pair judge's evidence template previously held as a core-code literal; no definition, switch, or prohibition changed and every rendered prompt is byte-identical (the domain-boundary test). Pin re-taken and pack_version bumped per docs/PACK_DESIGN.md SS1.2; the 0.1.0 payload bytes remain in git history.
